name: Abu Dhabi
title: Holidays in Abu Dhabi
intro: The UAE's capital, with a dazzling white mosque, the Louvre on the water, theme parks on Yas Island and calm beaches. Here's what Abu Dhabi is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The white domes and arches of Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 3 to 4 hrs ahead of the UK

facts.label: Plugs
facts.value: Type G · same as the UK

facts_note: Dress modestly at the mosque, where long clothes and headscarves for women are required. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: November to March is the best time, warm and sunny around 24 to 30°C. April and October are hot but manageable. From May to September it's extremely hot, so days are spent indoors, in the pool or at Yas Island's indoor parks.

things.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
things.blurb: A vast white mosque of marble domes and chandeliers. Book a free slot online.

things.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
things.blurb: Art from every era under a huge dome that lets in a rain of light.

things.name: Ferrari World
things.blurb: Home to one of the world's fastest roller coasters, on Yas Island.

things.name: Warner Bros. World and Yas Waterworld
things.blurb: An indoor theme park and a big water park, side by side.

things.name: Saadiyat Beach
things.blurb: A long natural beach with calm water and dunes.

things.name: Desert safari
things.blurb: Dune driving, camels and dinner in the desert.

faqs.question: Is Abu Dhabi or Dubai better?
faqs.answer: Abu Dhabi is calmer, with culture and theme parks. Dubai has more nightlife, shopping and big attractions.

faqs.question: Is Abu Dhabi good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Yas Island's theme parks, calm beaches and big pools make it popular for family holidays.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Abu Dhabi?
Can you visit Dubai from Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's about 1.5 hours by road, and buses run often.
